headline: Exchanges Took In 343.3 Million Dollars, Reversing A 61.0 Million Dollar Outflow
narrative: Exchanges took in 343.3 million dollars across assets over 24 hours, 0.1260 percent of custodied value, reversing a 61.0 million dollar outflow. The figure is the change in dollars held on trading venues excluding each exchange's own token, so a positive print means that money arrived where holders can sell. Binance took in 887.7 million dollars and Bitfinex took in 136.8 million, while OKX sent out 602.4 million.
author: jordan
